command: pre-registration of plan L's probe L1 (grounding predicts zero-shot failure)

hypotheses.GO: AUC of -min G for failure over the 40 pooled (policy, task) units >= 0.75
hypotheses.descriptive: per policy; secondary predictor; Spearman with the pooled success rate; bootstrap 95% CI over tasks

metrics.outcome: zero-shot success of the policy alone pooled over start-state sets c, d, e, f (80 episodes per task); failure = rate < 0.50
metrics.predictor_primary: min over the instruction's content words (object, goal, verb, relation if present) of the word grounding G(w) in the task's own OOD scene (10 first frames of fresh_ood_a; G = mean over alternatives of the swap's ||delta eps|| / ||eps(instr) - eps(null)||, t in 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8, shared noise); lower predicts failure
metrics.predictor_secondary: mean over the same words of G(w)
metrics.written_before: any L0a grounding score and experiments/pl1_predict.py
